featured_reviews.name: Yaana Dalvi
featured_reviews.review_text: Nirmala Mata Church, located in Vasai, Maharashtra, is a Roman Catholic church dedicated to the Immaculate Mother of God. This beautiful church is a site for Catholic devotees, attracting visitors from far and wide with its stunning architecture and peaceful ambiance. The church's significance extends beyond its aesthetic appeal, serving as a spiritual heaven where devotees seek guidance, and connection with the divine. The feast of Our Lady of Immaculate Conception is celebrated with great fervor, drawing large crowds. Throughout the year, the church offers various facilities, including daily Mass, confession, baptism, and marriage ceremonies. The church also engages in community services. Nirmala Mata Church is conveniently located in Vasai West, Maharashtra, making it easily accessible by road and rail. Devotees can reach the church via state highways or alight at Vasai Railway Station, which is just a short distance away. In addition to its spiritual significance, Nirmala Mata Church is surrounded by popular attractions, including Vasai Fort, Vasai Beach. These nearby landmarks offer a unique blend of history, culture, and natural beauty, making Vasai an ideal destination for tourists and pilgrims alike.

featured_reviews.review_text: A very small church with a very BIG heart! Fell in love with the church and the vibe it had the very first time i went there over 10 years ago. But because of the Redemptorist priests that are in charge of the Parish, it is very popular, and people from nearby parishes flock to it for Sunday masses and even more for Christmas, Holy Week etc. The priests are warm, welcoming and make it a point to meet all the people after every service. It is also very popular for the Wednesday novena to Our Lady of Perpetual Succour in English at 7.15 pm. Compared to some of the massive, ancient churches in Vasai, this one is very small, and pretty new.

featured_reviews.name: Yaana Dalvi
featured_reviews.review_text: Our Lady of Grace Cathedral, located in Vasai West, Maharashtra, is a historic Catholic church. Established by Portuguese Franciscan friars in 1534, the church has undergone multiple transformations, reflecting the region's rich cultural heritage. The current structure, built in 1750, showcases stunning Gothic-Portuguese architecture. Soft sunlight filters through the stained-glass windows, casting vibrant hues on the floor. Whether you're a history enthusiast, architecture aficionado, or spiritual seeker, Our Lady of Grace Cathedral offers a profound and enriching experience.

featured_reviews.name: Mahesh
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Saint Joseph's Church was the tallest church in Vasai Fort. It was used for regular prayers 450 years ago by Portuguese.
It was founded in 1546 but renovated and enlarged in 1601. Chakri Mala - The winding narrow steps inside its towering remains can be climbed till 60-70 feet for a magnificent view across the coast and a greenery.
If you see at the dome closely you can see a design in which angles faces can be seen in the background.
Vasai fort and the area was captured by Great Marathas under leadership of the Great Chimaji Appa after cutting off supplies and conquering Arnala fort which is on the north of Vasai.
now Vasai Fort and these remains are in very bad shape and need cleanliness and renovation.
Visit the place and don't forget to climb Chakri Mala to reach on the top to have a scenic view of greenery, Sea, boats and Sunset.

featured_reviews.name: Arjun Rampal Escovar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been a proud parishioner of St. Ignatius Loyola Church since 2009, and this church has been a central part of my spiritual journey. I received baptism here, got married within its sacred walls, and even my baby’s baptism took place here. Living close to the church has been a true blessing for my family, and it continues to play a vital role in our lives.

The church is uniquely designed with a beautiful hexagonal structure and a serene ambiance that makes every Mass deeply enriching. The altar, adorned with the image of the Sacred Heart of Jesus, creates a truly divine atmosphere. Masses are conducted in English and Konkani, making it accessible to a wide community. The vibrant celebrations of feasts like the Zolal Feast, organized with contributions from different zones, bring together the entire parish in joyous fellowship.

The Sunday School program is a highlight of the parish, providing children like my daughter with strong Christian foundations and values. The church’s pastoral leadership is exceptional, with our priests organizing not only regular retreats but also engaging activities like sports events and picnics that foster community spirit and camaraderie among parishioners.

St. Ignatius Loyola Church is more than just a place of worship; it is a thriving community where faith, fellowship, and family come together. I feel deeply privileged to be part of this parish and would encourage anyone seeking a welcoming and spiritually uplifting church to visit and experience its warmth and hospitality.
